niche: a municipal utility's commercial retrofit pilot drawn by lot, judged on verified normal-weather gas savings for its 2026 round
answer: Fund insulation and heating optimisation in the 2026 round, not heating controls: saving rates 16, 6 and 2 per cent from the 2019 pilot against passed-over buildings not yet visited, so €90, €90 and €220 of grant a tonne against the €120 limit; the funded round about €8 million and 90,000 lifetime tonnes once the offer closes; the pilot's works saved about 3,500 tonnes of CO2 in 2025/26
analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans the meter reads, normalises every season as the utility does and compares the drawn buildings with the passed-over ones (the lottery's randomised comparison, as a difference in differences on the notice season) finds insulation about 12 per cent, heating optimisation 3 and controls below zero and funds insulation alone, or reads the narrowing gap as fading savings and funds less.
domain_test: The call turns on each retrofit measure's verified saving on weather-normalised gas use, the measurement and verification question of what the works saved against a comparison, which here must leave out buildings whose burners the utility's service team tuned; with another field's nouns there is no burner tuning that moves the same metered gas, no degree-day normalisation and no service-visit meter read that dates it.
layer1: meter points re-keyed at meter exchanges
billing periods not aligned to calendar months
tenant changes on the same building
a weather station gap filled from a neighbour
stakeholder_role: head of energy services at the municipal utility
driver: The decisive quantity is the effect of a treatment assigned by lottery, where the units the lottery passed over were reached one area at a time by a second programme that skipped the winners and moved the same outcome for good, so the randomised comparison narrows period by period as if the effect faded; only passed-over units the second programme had not yet reached give the counterfactual, and the effect then decides which options a forward round funds against a cost-per-unit limit.
driver_concrete: Haldenau's 2019 retrofit pilot drew its places by lot among the owners who answered the benchmarking notice's offer, so the owners passed over are the natural comparison; but the utility's service team tuned the burners of most of them, district by district from September 2019, and skipped every building with pilot works, so the passed-over buildings' gas use steps down and the measures' savings appear to fade; set against passed-over buildings not yet tuned, the savings hold, and heating optimisation clears the council's cost-per-tonne limit.
stump: A competent solver reads the pilot as the randomised trial it was drawn as, measures each measure's saving as the works buildings' weather-normalised gas use against the passed-over buildings' on the notice season, sees the gap narrow every season and averages it or reads it as savings fading, and funds insulation alone in 2026; the step that lands it there is trusting a comparison whose buildings the service team was tuning district by district while it skipped the works buildings, when against passed-over buildings not yet tuned heating optimisation saves about six per cent and clears the limit.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many of the period's placeable units a fixed team can finish before the period closes, because each unit counts only once that team performs one last step for it, the team's spare weekly capacity is visible only as the ceiling it held through an earlier unrelated surge, and the decision's own volume, bunched by its filed calendar into weeks no closed period approached, queues the later units past the close; the closed record's lag and an annual capacity check both pass, so the placeable count overstates the in-period total wherever the team is small and the units are many.

notes: architecture 6 (2026-11-08) Architecture 6's first mechanism (take-up of an offer made once on a high season, driven by the rise into it; the counterfactual conditioned on the pre-notice seasons) was priced at design on 2026-11-08 and redrawn before any pack: selection on a rise brackets the truth (a twelve-month baseline over, a long baseline under), the eligible comparison on a panel landed within about a point, and the golden family's own spread (5.0 to 6.3 per cent on heating optimisation) crossed every decision bar; its driver was: The decisive quantity is the effect of a treatment on units enrolled because a noisy yearly measure of them ran high, so their own before-and-after fall carries that measure's regression and only units flagged by the same measure and left untreated give the counterfactual; the outcome is normalised to a reference exposure through a threshold each unit sets and the treatment itself moves, so a common threshold misstates the change whenever the after years' exposure differs.
